bio.text: Tom Cole is serving his eleventh term in the U.S. House of Representatives for Oklahoma and is Chairman of the House Appropriations Committee.
Earlier he served in the Oklahoma State Senate and as Oklahoma's Secretary of State, and was chairman of the Oklahoma Republican Party.
He holds a B.A. from Grinnell College, an M.A. from Yale University and a Ph.D. from the University of Oklahoma; he is an enrolled member of the Chickasaw Nation and lives in Moore, Oklahoma.
